metadata.notes: Folleto promocional de Calvert (whisky) que ofrece una guía de bebidas refrescantes para clima caluroso. Material publicitario que incluye 39 recetas en lugar de las 77 anunciadas en portada (parece estar incompleto el OCR). Todas las recetas usan whisky Calvert como ingrediente base.

sections.content_original: The first half of this handy mixing manual for cooling summer drinks is devoted to tall and short cooler-offers, all of which can be concocted from ingredients already in your liquor cabinet... or pantry... or safe... or wherever you hoard your stock. Ingredients: Whiskey, Gin, Vermouth, Bitters, Grenadine. The second half of this handy mixing manual for cooling summer drinks is given over to heat allayers whose preparation calls for a greater variety of ingredients and perhaps for a hurried trip to the corner liquor store... or cigar store... or wherever you buy your makings. Ingredients: Whiskey, Gin, Sloe Gin, Vermouth, Bitters, Grenadine, D. O. M. Benedictine, Curacao, Maraschino, Sherry, Cointreau, Claret, Creme de Menthe, Peppermint, Brandy, Dubonnet, Rum, Grand Marnier.
sections.content_es: La primera mitad de este práctico manual de coctelería para bebidas refrescantes de verano está dedicada a tragos largos y cortos, todos los cuales pueden prepararse con ingredientes que ya tiene en su mueble bar... o despensa... o caja fuerte... o donde guarde su reserva. Ingredientes: Whisky, Ginebra, Vermut, Amargos, Granadina. La segunda mitad de este práctico manual está dedicada a refrescantes cuya preparación requiere una mayor variedad de ingredientes y quizás un viaje apresurado a la licorería de la esquina... o estanco... o donde compre sus suministros. Ingredientes: Whisky, Ginebra, Ginebra de endrinas (Sloe Gin), Vermut, Amargos, Granadina, D. O. M. Benedictine, Curaçao, Maraschino, Jerez, Cointreau, Clarete, Crema de Menta, Menta, Brandy, Dubonnet, Ron, Grand Marnier.

sections.title: Another Pet Theory Walks the Plank - Whiskey is Heating
sections.title_es: Otra teoría favorita cae por la borda - El whisky calienta
sections.content_original: Scientists have a big advantage over laymen. They can get behind popular superstitions and discover the truth. For many years, now, they've known that whiskey is really cooling. It actually lowers body temperature. Even the Russians, under the Czar, were wise to that fact. Before starting a march through the snow they always inspected breaths. Those with whiskey on 'em were left behind. Reason: they couldn't stand the cold. Inhabitants of hot countries have known about it, too. So have seasoned travelers of the tropics. Statistics show that these people use from twice to thirty times as much whiskey as they do any other distilled liquor. The smartest cruise ships, plying tropical waters, serve Calvert as their standard bar whiskey. Calvert is more congenial whiskey. That's why. Take a tip from those in the 'know'—clear heads cool off with Calvert!
sections.content_es: Los científicos tienen una gran ventaja sobre los profanos. Pueden ir más allá de las supersticiones populares y descubrir la verdad. Durante muchos años han sabido que el whisky es realmente refrescante. De hecho, baja la temperatura corporal. Incluso los rusos, bajo el zar, eran conscientes de ese hecho. Antes de comenzar una marcha por la nieve, siempre inspeccionaban los alientos. Los que tenían whisky eran dejados atrás. Razón: no podían soportar el frío. Los habitantes de países cálidos también lo han sabido. Y los viajeros experimentados de los trópicos. Las estadísticas muestran que estas personas usan entre dos y treinta veces más whisky que cualquier otro licor destilado. Los mejores cruceros que navegan por aguas tropicales sirven Calvert como su whisky estándar de bar. Calvert es un whisky más agradable. Por eso. Sigue el consejo de los entendidos: ¡las cabezas claras se refrescan con Calvert!

Master blends of the man who has blended more whiskey than any living American. Returned to the original casks after blending until 'perfectly married'. Lord Calvert... for special occasions... straight, 100 proof, five year old whiskey, available in either Rye or Bourbon. Bottled in bond under Canadian Government supervision.
sections.content_es: Calvert's Special Reserve y Calvert's Special... dos magníficas mezclas de calidad y sabor invariables. Mezclas maestras del hombre que ha mezclado más whisky que cualquier americano vivo. Devueltas a los barriles originales después de mezclar hasta quedar 'perfectamente casadas'. Lord Calvert... para ocasiones especiales... whisky puro, 100 grados, de cinco años, disponible en Rye o Bourbon. Embotellado en bond bajo supervisión del gobierno canadiense.

sections.content_original: First requirement for shattering the heat is... Calvert. Second is... a cool drink containing it. The Calvert cocktail recipe book... a guide to cooling, hot-weather drinks... is also an essential. Gives you selected recipes for mixing the finest cooler-offers, from juleps to before-dinner cocktails. No properly run home should be without it. Clear heads cool off with Calvert.
sections.content_es: El primer requisito para romper el calor es... Calvert. El segundo es... una bebida fría que lo contenga. El libro de recetas de cócteles Calvert... una guía de bebidas refrescantes para clima caluroso... también es esencial. Le ofrece recetas seleccionadas para mezclar los mejores refrescantes, desde juleps hasta cócteles antes de la cena. Ninguna casa bien gestionada debería estar sin él. Las cabezas claras se refrescan con Calvert.

sections.title: Measurements Guide
sections.content_original: 1 jigger is 1.5 ounces (3 tablespoons). 1 dash equals 1/8 teaspoon. 1 wineglass equals approximately 2 ounces. 1 pony is 1 ounce. If you don't have standard measuring devices, you are safe so long as you get your proportions right. For instance, if you're mixing cocktails for a group of people, and recipe says 1 jigger of this, 1/2 of that, and 1 jigger of the other, you'll save yourself a lot of trouble by pouring in 1 cup of this, 1/2 cup of that, and 1 cup of the other. It's really very simple, and the results are amazing! Only before you start measuring in cupfuls, be sure you have extra guests on hand!
sections.content_es: 1 jigger equivale a 1,5 onzas (3 cucharadas). 1 dash (chorrito) equivale a 1/8 cucharadita. 1 copa de vino equivale aproximadamente a 2 onzas. 1 pony es 1 onza. Si no tiene instrumentos de medición estándar, está seguro siempre que mantenga las proporciones correctas. Por ejemplo, si está preparando cócteles para un grupo de personas y la receta dice 1 jigger de esto, 1/2 de aquello y 1 jigger del otro, se ahorrará mucho problema vertiendo 1 taza de esto, 1/2 taza de aquello y 1 taza del otro. ¡Es realmente muy simple y los resultados son sorprendentes! Solo asegúrese de tener invitados extra a mano antes de empezar a medir en tazas.

recipes.method_original: Slide a highball glass under one (1) ice cube. Over the ice cube pour one (1) jigger of Calvert. Fizz into this simple mixture as much carbonated water as you want. If the drink looks shallow, drop in a piece of lemon peel with a bar spoon to crush it.
recipes.method_es: Coloque un vaso highball debajo de un (1) cubo de hielo. Sobre el cubo de hielo vierta un (1) jigger de Calvert. Añada tanta agua carbonatada como desee. Si la bebida parece poco profunda, añada un trozo de cáscara de limón y aplástelo con una cuchara de bar.
recipes.raw_text:
REFRIGERATOR HIGH BALL
      I jigger Calvert
      Carbonated water
    Lemon peel
 Slide a highball glass under one (1) ice cube. Over the ice cube pour one (1) jigger of Calvert. Fizz into this simple mixture as much carbonated water as you want. If the drink looks shallow, drop in a piece of lemon peel with a bar spoon to crush it, poor thing! Relax and enjoy.

recipes.method_original: Equip yourself with an ice crusher, a burlap bag or a hammer. Because this drink should be served with crushed ice.
recipes.method_es: Equípese con un triturador de hielo, una bolsa de arpillera o un martillo. Porque esta bebida debe servirse con hielo picado.
recipes.raw_text:
GLACIER HIGH BALL
      1/2 Calvert
      1/2 Ginger ale
      Slice of lemon
 Equip yourself with an ice crusher, a burlap bag or a hammer. Because this drink should be served with crushed ice.

recipes.method_original: To a highball glass half full of cracked ice, add the powdered sugar. Before drinking, add the jigger of Calvert and several slices of orange and pineapple. These little touches add a lot.
recipes.method_es: A un vaso highball lleno hasta la mitad de hielo picado, añada el azúcar en polvo. Antes de beber, añada el jigger de Calvert y varias rodajas de naranja y piña. Estos pequeños toques aportan mucho.
recipes.raw_text:
ALASKA COBBLER
      I jigger Calvert
      I teaspoon powdered sugar
       Several slices of orange and pineapple
 To a highball glass half full of cracked ice, add the powdered sugar. Before drinking, add the jigger of Calvert and several slices of orange and pineapple. These little touches add a lot.

recipes.method_original: Add ice and shake well. Strain and serve with small piece of pineapple (if you like decoration) in a small highball glass.
recipes.method_es: Añada hielo y agite bien. Cuele y sirva con un pequeño trozo de piña (si le gusta la decoración) en un vaso highball pequeño.
recipes.raw_text:
ICICLE SOUR
      1 jigger Calvert
      I teaspoon grenadine
    Juice of 1/2 lemon or lime
 Add ice and shake well. (Not you, George—the cocktail shaker.) Strain and serve with small piece of pineapple (if you like decoration) in a small highball glass.

recipes.method_original: Dissolve 1/2 piece of lump sugar with a little carbonated water in an old-fashioned glass. To this add 4 sprigs of mint and muddle slightly. Insert one cube of ice and the jigger of Calvert. Serve with the remaining sprig of mint.
recipes.method_es: Disuelva 1/2 terrón de azúcar con un poco de agua carbonatada en un vaso old-fashioned. Añada 4 ramitas de menta y macere ligeramente. Inserte un cubo de hielo y el jigger de Calvert. Sirva con la ramita de menta restante.
recipes.raw_text:
ZERO SMASH
      1 jigger Calvert
      5 sprigs mint
      Lump sugar
 Dissolve 1/2 piece of lump sugar with a little carbonated water in an old-fashioned glass. To this add 4 sprigs of mint and muddle slightly. Insert one cube of ice and the jigger of Calvert. Serve with the remaining sprig of mint. This one will make your teeth chatter.

recipes.method_original: Into a highball glass half full of cracked ice, pour the wineglass of Calvert. Add the juice of the lime. Squirt carbonated water till the glass is full-up. Serve with small bar spoon.
recipes.method_es: En un vaso highball lleno hasta la mitad de hielo picado, vierta la copa de vino de Calvert. Añada el zumo de la lima. Eche agua carbonatada hasta llenar el vaso. Sirva con cuchara pequeña de bar.
recipes.raw_text:
BOB SLED RICKEY
      1 wineglass Calvert
      1 lime
      Carbonated water
 Into a highball glass half full of cracked ice, pour the wineglass of Calvert. Add the juice of the lime. Squirt carbonated water till the glass is full-up. Serve with small bar spoon.

recipes.method_original: Fill highball glass 1/2 full of shaved ice. Stir well and ornament with fruit in season, being careful not to use whole pineapple.
recipes.method_es: Llene un vaso highball hasta la mitad con hielo en escarcha. Remueva bien y adorne con fruta de temporada, teniendo cuidado de no usar piña entera.
recipes.raw_text:
POLAR BEAR
       I wineglass Calvert
       I teaspoon powdered sugar
       Juice lemon
  Fill highball glass 1/2 full of shaved ice. (No, Charley, ice doesn't have whiskers!) Stir well and ornament with fruit in season, being careful not to use whole pineapple.

recipes.method_original: Pour in shaker, add ice and exercise. Pour into cocktail glasses with an olive and a little nutmeg. This cocktail is very dry, but don't let that deceive you!
recipes.method_es: Vierta en coctelera, añada hielo y agite. Sirva en vasos de cóctel con una aceituna y un poco de nuez moscada. Este cóctel es muy seco, pero no se deje engañar.
recipes.raw_text:
CHEVY CHASE COCKTAIL
      3 jiggers Calvert
      1/2 jiggers French Vermouth
      1/2 jigger orange juice
 Pour in shaker, add ice and exercise. Pour into cocktail glasses with an olive and a little nutmeg. This cocktail is very dry, but don't let that deceive you!

recipes.method_original: Shake with ice, strain into cocktail glass, serve with maraschino cherry.
recipes.method_es: Agite con hielo, cuele en un vaso de cóctel, sirva con una cereza al maraschino.
recipes.raw_text:
MOUNTAIN DEW COCKTAIL
            1/3 Calvert
            1/3 orange juice
            1/3 grape juice
 Shake with ice, strain into cocktail glass, serve with maraschino cherry. Provide saucer for guests who do not eat maraschinos, and suggest marble tournament after third round of drinks.

recipes.method_original: Mix well with cracked ice. Strain into cocktail glass. Save what pineapple juice you have left over for breakfast tomorrow morning.
recipes.method_es: Mezcle bien con hielo picado. Cuele en un vaso de cóctel. Guarde el zumo de piña que le sobre para el desayuno de mañana.
recipes.raw_text:
PINE ORCHARD COCKTAIL
             1/2 Calvert
             1/2 pineapple juice
 Mix well with cracked ice. Strain into cocktail glass. Save what pineapple juice you have left over for breakfast tomorrow morning. You'll enjoy it if you've kept to Calvert!

recipes.method_original: Shake in ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass. Refreshing as a sea breeze, and really much more tasty!
recipes.method_es: Agite con hielo. Cuele y sirva en vaso de cóctel. Refrescante como una brisa marina, ¡y mucho más sabroso!
recipes.raw_text:
SEA BREEZE COCKTAIL
      1/3 Calvert
      1/3 grapefruit juice
      1/3 grenadine
 Shake in ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass. Refreshing as a sea breeze, and really much more tasty!

recipes.method_original: Half an hour before julep is to be served, pour 1 jigger Calvert over the sprigs of mint. Submerge in a little water in another tumbler 1 teaspoon sugar. Remove sprigs of mint from glass containing Calvert. Pour Calvert into sugar glass and vice versa. Continue this until the sugar is thoroughly dissolved. Now pour the combined liquid into a goblet filled with finely crushed ice and stir vigorously until frost forms on the glass. Garnish with sprigs of mint.
recipes.method_es: Media hora antes de servir el julep, vierta 1 jigger de Calvert sobre las ramitas de menta. Sumerja en un poco de agua en otro vaso 1 cucharadita de azúcar. Retire las ramitas de menta del vaso con Calvert. Vierta el Calvert en el vaso del azúcar y viceversa. Continúe esto hasta que el azúcar se disuelva por completo. Ahora vierta el líquido combinado en una copa llena de hielo finamente picado y remueva vigorosamente hasta que se forme escarcha en el vaso. Decore con ramitas de menta.
recipes.raw_text:
HOARFROST MINT JULEP
      1 jigger Calvert
       1 teaspoon sugar
       Several sprigs of mint
 Half an hour before julep is to be served, pour 1 jigger Calvert over the sprigs of mint. Submerge in a little water in another tumbler 1 teaspoon sugar. Remove sprigs of mint from glass containing Calvert. Pour Calvert into sugar glass and vice versa. Continue this until the sugar is thoroughly dissolved. Now pour the combined liquid into a goblet filled with finely crushed ice and stir vigorously until frost forms on the glass. Garnish with sprigs of mint.

recipes.method_original: Shake well in cracked ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado. Cuele y sirva en vaso de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text:
ANNAPOLIS COCKTAIL
          1 jigger Calvert
          1 tablespoon lemon juice
          1 tablespoon orange juice
          1 tablespoon grenadine
 Shake well in cracked ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass. Separate drink from cocktail glass by sipping.

recipes.method_original: Press the strawberries through a fine sieve. Add the Calvert and the orange juice. Shake carefully with a few cubes of ice and strain into cocktail glasses. Serves six people once.
recipes.method_es: Pase las fresas por un colador fino. Añada el Calvert y el zumo de naranja. Agite cuidadosamente con unos cubos de hielo y cuele en vasos de cóctel. Sirve a seis personas una vez.
recipes.raw_text:
STRAWBERRY COVE COCKTAIL
          4 jiggers Calvert
          1 pound strawberries
          Juice 1 orange
 Press the strawberries through a fine sieve. Add the Calvert and the orange juice. Shake carefully with a few cubes of ice and strain into cocktail glasses. Serves six people once, or one person six times. But you'd better round up five other people!

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice. Strain into cocktail glass. Place in front of one guest and watch it disappear.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado. Cuele en vaso de cóctel. Coloque frente a un invitado y observe cómo desaparece.
recipes.raw_text:
HILLTOP COCKTAIL
      1/2 Calvert
      1/4 Italian Vermouth
         grapefruit juice
      1 dash grenadine
      1 dash bitters
 Shake well with cracked ice. Strain into cocktail glass. Place front of one guest and watch it disappear. (The cocktail, of course!)

recipes.method_original: Shake well and strain into a Tom Collins glass, 1/2 full of shaved ice. Decorate with fruit. For a bit of elan, if you wish, give it two dashes of brandy. Serve with straw.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien y cuele en un vaso Tom Collins, lleno hasta la mitad con hielo en escarcha. Decore con fruta. Para darle un toque, si lo desea, añada dos chorritos de brandy. Sirva con pajita.
recipes.raw_text:
FRIGID ZONE PUNCH
      1 cocktail glass Calvert
       1/2 pony lime juice
      1 pony pineapple juice
      1 teaspoon powdered sugar
      1 dash maraschino (take it from your bottle of cherries)
 Shake well and strain into a Tom Collins glass, 1/2 full of shaved ice. Decorate with fruit. For a bit of elan, if you wish, give it two dashes of brandy. Serve with straw for particular hey-hey!

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice. Strain into Tom Collins glass. Zip in some carbonated water until the glass is full. Supply each guest with raccoon coat when serving.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado. Cuele en vaso Tom Collins. Añada agua carbonatada hasta llenar el vaso. Provea a cada invitado con un abrigo de mapache al servir.
recipes.raw_text:
40-BELOW PUNCH
           1 jigger Calvert
           1 tablespoon powdered sugar
         1 dash grenadine
         Juice 1 lemon
         Juice 1 lime
 Shake well with cracked ice. Strain into Tom Collins glass. Zip in some carbonated water until the glass is full. Supply each guest with raccoon coat when serving.

recipes.method_original: Shake well and strain into highball glass 1/2 full of finely shaved ice. Complete filling of glass with mineral water. Mix thoroughly with spoon and serve. Toss this one off as soon as it's mixed if you want to enjoy its full flavor.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien y cuele en vaso highball lleno hasta la mitad de hielo finamente picado. Complete el llenado del vaso con agua mineral. Mezcle bien con cuchara y sirva. Tómela tan pronto como esté mezclada si quiere disfrutar todo su sabor.
recipes.raw_text:
FROSTY SIDE FIZZ
          1 wineglass Calvert
          1/2 tablespoonful powdered sugar
          3 dashes lemon juice
           Yolk of 1 egg
 Shake well and strain into highball glass 1/2 full of finely shaved ice. Complete filling of glass with mineral water. Mix thoroughly with spoon and serve. Toss this one off as soon as it's mixed if you want to enjoy its full flavor.

recipes.method_original: Mix in large bowl in order named. Place one large lump of ice in center of things and stir well. Dip the finished punch into claret glasses. Serves twenty people.
recipes.method_es: Mezcle en un cuenco grande en el orden indicado. Coloque un gran trozo de hielo en el centro y remueva bien. Sirva el ponche terminado en copas de clarete. Sirve a veinte personas.
recipes.raw_text:
DAMASCUS CUP FREEZE
      4 quarts Calvert
      4 quarts water
      1 1/2 pounds sugar
      1 pineapple, pared and sliced
      1/2 bottle grenadine
 Mix in large bowl in order named. Place one large lump of ice in center of things and stir well. Dip the finished punch into claret glasses. Serves twenty people.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice and strain into cocktail glass. Simple, isn't it?
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado y cuele en vaso de cóctel. Sencillo, ¿verdad?
recipes.raw_text:
SNOW HILL COCKTAIL
      1/2 Calvert
      1/2 cream
 Shake well with cracked ice and strain into cocktail glass. Simple, isn't it?

recipes.method_original: Crush mint in large goblet. Fill glass with crushed ice. Add Calvert. Pour over this 1/2 glass of sugared water. Decorate with sprigs of mint. Let stand a moment before serving.
recipes.method_es: Triture la menta en una copa grande. Llene el vaso con hielo picado. Añada el Calvert. Vierta sobre esto 1/2 vaso de agua azucarada. Decore con ramitas de menta. Deje reposar un momento antes de servir.
recipes.raw_text:
COLD SPRINGS MINT JULEP
        1 jigger Calvert
        4 sprigs mint
        1/2 tablespoon sugar
 Crush mint in large goblet. Fill glass with crushed ice. Add Calvert. Pour over this 1/2 glass of sugared water. Decorate with sprigs of mint. Let stand a moment before serving.

ingredients.notes: lo suficiente para disolver el azúcar

recipes.method_original: Cover 12 to 15 leaves of mint with tablespoonful powdered sugar. Add enough water to dissolve sugar. Crush mint gently for about five minutes. Put in pewter tankard about the size of a Tom Collins glass (16 ounces). Fill half full of shaved ice and put in refrigerator for two hours. An hour before serving, fill tankard with Calvert. When ready to serve, add 2 sprigs of mint sprinkled with powdered sugar. Insert straw. If drink is frozen too solidly, make way with ice pick.
recipes.method_es: Cubra de 12 a 15 hojas de menta con una cucharada de azúcar en polvo. Añada suficiente agua para disolver el azúcar. Triture la menta suavemente durante unos cinco minutos. Coloque en una jarra de peltre del tamaño de un vaso Tom Collins (16 onzas). Llene hasta la mitad con hielo en escarcha y meta en el refrigerador durante dos horas. Una hora antes de servir, llene la jarra con Calvert. Cuando esté listo para servir, añada 2 ramitas de menta espolvoreadas con azúcar en polvo. Inserte una pajita. Si la bebida está demasiado congelada, abra paso con un punzón para hielo.
recipes.garnish: 2 ramitas de menta espolvoreadas con azúcar en polvo
recipes.raw_text:
SLEET SPECIAL MINT JULEP
(This julep entails much trouble. But the result is in the best Maryland tradition.)
 Cover 12 to 15 leaves of mint with tablespoonful powdered sugar. Add enough water to dissolve sugar. Crush mint gently for about five minutes. Put in pewter tankard about the size of a Tom Collins glass (16 ounces). Fill half full of shaved ice and put in refrigerator for two hours. An hour before serving, fill tankard with Calvert. When ready to serve, add 2 sprigs of mint sprinkled with powdered sugar. Insert straw. If drink is frozen too solidly, make way with ice pick.

recipes.method_original: Shake well. Strain into highball glass half filled with cracked ice. Fill with carbonated water.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien. Cuele en vaso highball lleno hasta la mitad con hielo picado. Llene con agua carbonatada.
recipes.raw_text:
ICELAND FIZZ
       1/2 Calvert
       1/2 [Rum?]
       4 dashes lemon juice
       Juice 1/2 lime
 Shake well. Strain into highball glass half filled with cracked ice. Fill with carbonated water. Don't think the weather's changing—it's just yourself, getting cooler.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice. Strain and serve in small highball glass.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado. Cuele y sirva en vaso highball pequeño.
recipes.raw_text:
HAILSTONE SOUR
      [?] Calvert
      1 dash D. O. M. Benedictine
       Juice 1/2 lime
      Dash Grand Marnier
 Shake well with cracked ice. Strain and serve in high smallball glass. No, no. Smigh hallball glass. Beg pardon—small highball glass!

recipes.method_original: Stir well in shaved ice. Serve in delmonico (small highball) glass with straw. Ornament with fruits in season.
recipes.method_es: Remueva bien con hielo en escarcha. Sirva en vaso delmonico (highball pequeño) con pajita. Adorne con frutas de temporada.
recipes.raw_text:
SOUTH POLE PUNCH
      1/2 wineglass Calvert
      1/2 wineglass carbonated water
      1/2 wineglass rum
      1/2 wineglass brandy
      1 small tablespoon sugar
      2 dashes lemon juice
 Stir well in shaved ice. Serve in delmonico (small highball) glass with straw. Ornament with fruits in season.

recipes.method_original: Mix in highball glass, stirring gently. Add carbonated water.
recipes.method_es: Mezcle en vaso highball, removiendo suavemente. Añada agua carbonatada.
recipes.raw_text:
ICE FLOW COCKTAIL
      1/2 wineglass Calvert
      2 teaspoons pineapple juice
      1/4 teaspoon lemon juice
      1/2 wineglass sherry
      2 lumps ice
 Mix in highball glass, stirring gently. Add carbonated water. If you can't get away to Maine, this is one good way of escaping the heat.

recipes.method_original: Lay mint leaves in a cloth on ice. Dissolve sugar in water. Chill Calvert, brandy and sugared water for six hours. At serving time, rub a slice of lemon around rim of each goblet. Half fill the goblet with sugared water. Add one teaspoon of cracked ice and stand sprigs of mint thickly around the rim. Then fill with Calvert and brandy. Drop a fresh ripe strawberry, cherry or slice of red peach in the middle, and serve pronto.
recipes.method_es: Coloque las hojas de menta en un paño sobre hielo. Disuelva el azúcar en agua. Enfríe el Calvert, brandy y agua azucarada durante seis horas. Al servir, frote una rodaja de limón por el borde de cada copa. Llene la copa hasta la mitad con agua azucarada. Añada una cucharadita de hielo picado y coloque ramitas de menta densamente alrededor del borde. Luego llene con Calvert y brandy. Coloque una fresa fresca y madura, cereza o rodaja de melocotón rojo en el centro, y sirva enseguida.
recipes.garnish: fresa fresca, cereza o rodaja de melocotón rojo, ramitas de menta
recipes.raw_text:
ICE BOUND MINT JULEP
                 Calvert
      1/2 jigger brandy
      4 lumps sugar
       1/2 goblet cold water
       Several sprigs mint
 Lay mint leaves in a cloth on ice. Dissolve sugar in water. Chill Calvert, brandy and sugared water for six hours. At serving time, rub a slice of lemon around rim of each goblet. Half fill the goblet with sugared water. Add one teaspoon of cracked ice and stand sprigs of mint thickly around the rim. Then fill with Calvert and brandy. Drop a fresh ripe strawberry, cherry or slice of red peach in the middle, and serve pronto.

recipes.method_original: Shake with cracked ice, strain into cocktail glass and serve with a stuffed olive.
recipes.method_es: Agite con hielo picado, cuele en vaso de cóctel y sirva con una aceituna rellena.
recipes.raw_text:
PENT HOUSE COCKTAIL
           1/2 jigger Calvert
           1/2 jigger Cointreau or D. O. M. Benedictine
           1/2 jigger grapefruit juice
 Shake with cracked ice, strain into cocktail glass and serve with a stuffed olive. If you can't find a stuffed olive, serve with a very close friend.

recipes.method_original: Shake with cracked ice. Strain into highball glass and fill up with carbonated water.
recipes.method_es: Agite con hielo picado. Cuele en vaso highball y llene con agua carbonatada.
recipes.raw_text:
SIBERIAN FIZZ
         1 jigger Calvert
           5 dashes lemon juice
           1 teaspoon sugar
           1 egg
           3 dashes Curacao
 Shake with cracked ice. Strain into highball glass and fill up with carbonated water. Anyone drinking this is immediately exiled—from the heat.

recipes.method_original: Shake in plenty of cracked ice until shaker is frosted. Strain into cocktail glasses. Serves 6 people.
recipes.method_es: Agite con abundante hielo picado hasta que la coctelera esté escarchada. Cuele en vasos de cóctel. Sirve a 6 personas.
recipes.raw_text:
SNOW FLAKE COCKTAIL
       4 jiggers Calvert
       1 small teaspoon Angostura bitters
       1 small teaspoon Curacao
      2 teaspoons creme de menthe
      2 lumps sugar
 Shake in plenty of cracked ice until shaker is frosted. Strain into cocktail glasses. Be careful guests don't mistake pillows for snowballs and start throwing them around. Serves 6 people.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass. For larger proportions, use measures to scale.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo. Cuele y sirva en vaso de cóctel. Para proporciones mayores, use medidas a escala.
recipes.raw_text:
MOUNTAIN TOP COCKTAIL
      1/3 wineglass Calvert
      1/3 wineglass Italian vermouth
      1/3 wineglass sloe gin
 Shake well with ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass. For larger proportions, use measures to scale. (You always scale a Mountain Top)

recipes.method_original: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.
recipes.method_es: Agite con hielo y cuele en vaso de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text:
LAWN PARTY COCKTAIL
          wineglass Calvert
      1/3 wineglass lime juice
      1/3 wineglass D. O. M. Benedictine
      1 dash bitters
 Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass. This drink is one of the best reasons ever invented for giving a lawn party except, of course, the lawn itself, if you happen to have one on your hands.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice, strain into a small highball glass and serve with sliced orange, lemon and sherry. This is technically known as garnishing.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado, cuele en un vaso highball pequeño y sirva con rodajas de naranja, limón y jerez. Esto se conoce técnicamente como guarnición.
recipes.garnish: rodaja de naranja, limón y jerez
recipes.raw_text:
ICE BOAT SOUR
       1 jigger Calvert
       2 dashes white creme de menthe
       juice 1 lemon
       1 tablespoon sugar
       1 dash Curacao
 Shake well with cracked ice, strain into a small highball glass and serve with sliced orange, lemon and sherry. This is technically known as garnishing.

recipes.method_original: Stir well in ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass.
recipes.method_es: Remueva bien con hielo. Cuele y sirva en vaso de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text:
MOUNT AIRY COCKTAIL
           wineglass Calvert
           wineglass D. O. M. Benedictine
      1/3 wineglass ginger ale
 Stir well in ice. Strain and serve in cocktail glass. Notice how the conversation veers to the cooling effects of Calvert.

recipes.method_original: Stir well in ice and strain into cocktail glass. Particularly enjoyable with music. Suggested theme song: 'Maryland, my Maryland.'
recipes.method_es: Remueva bien con hielo y cuele en vaso de cóctel. Particularmente disfrutable con música. Canción sugerida: 'Maryland, my Maryland.'
recipes.raw_text:
MARYLAND COCKTAIL
       1/3 jigger Calvert
       1/3 jigger French vermouth
       1/3 jigger Dubonnet
       1/3 jigger Orange juice
       1 slice orange
 Stir well in ice and strain into cocktail glass. Particularly enjoyable with music. Suggested theme song: 'Maryland, my Maryland.'

recipes.method_original: Put it all together. Sugar to taste. Stir. Ice thoroughly. Serve in Old Fashioned Glasses.
recipes.method_es: Junte todo. Azúcar al gusto. Remueva. Enfríe bien. Sirva en vasos Old Fashioned.
recipes.raw_text:
LITTLE AMERICA PUNCH
            (Serves 20 people)
           3 quarts Calvert
            1 pint rum
            3 quarts carbonated water
            7 lemons
            1 pineapple, sliced thin
 Put it all together. Sugar to taste. Stir. Ice thoroughly. Serve in Old Fashioned Glasses. Imagine yourself in Marie Byrd Land while enjoying. Little America was never like this!

recipes.method_original: Stir well with cracked ice, strain and serve in cocktail glasses.
recipes.method_es: Remueva bien con hielo picado, cuele y sirva en vasos de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text:
TOBOGGAN SLIDE
           1/2 wineglass Calvert
           1/2 wineglass Sherry
           2 dashes bitters
           2 dashes Grand Marnier
 Stir well with cracked ice, strain and serve in cocktail glasses. Be careful taking corners!

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice. Pour while frothing.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado. Sirva mientras forma espuma.
recipes.raw_text:
SNOWBALL
       1/3 jigger Calvert
       1/3 jigger grapefruit juice
       1/3 jigger honey
 Shake well with cracked ice. Pour while frothing. This, as we need hardly tell you, is a honey. Guests make a bee-line for it.

recipes.method_original: Stir well with spoon. Pour into glass half-filled with finely shaved ice.
recipes.method_es: Remueva bien con cuchara. Sirva en vaso lleno hasta la mitad con hielo finamente picado.
recipes.raw_text:
SKATERS' SPECIAL
      1 wineglass Calvert
       1/2 pony Chartreuse
    3 dashes lemon juice
    1 dash lime juice
    1/2 tablespoonful sugar
 Stir well with spoon. Pour into glass half-filled with finely shaved ice. Request guests to deposit ice skates outside house, because who wants to ruin a perfectly good floor with people trying to skate their names over it.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice, strain and serve with twist of orange peel in cocktail glass.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado, cuele y sirva con un twist de cáscara de naranja en vaso de cóctel.
recipes.raw_text:
SNOWSHOE COCKTAIL
           1/2 jigger Calvert
           1/2 jigger Dubonnet
           2 dashes bitters
           2 dashes Cointreau
            1 piece lemon peel
            2 pieces orange peel
 Shake well with cracked ice, strain and serve with twist of orange peel in cocktail glass. If you plan to have more than two of these, plan also to have near at hand a copy of Robert W. Service's The Cremation of Sam Magee— a thrilling story of the frozen North.

recipes.method_original: Shake well with cracked ice. Strain and serve in small highball glass with nutmeg on top. Grate the nutmeg.
recipes.method_es: Agite bien con hielo picado. Cuele y sirva en vaso highball pequeño con nuez moscada por encima. Ralle la nuez moscada.
recipes.raw_text:
SKI FLIP
           1 jigger Calvert
           1 teaspoon powdered sugar
               1/2 pony essence-of-peppermint
 Shake well with cracked ice. Strain and serve in small highball glass with nutmeg on top. Grate the nutmeg. Don't use a whole one or somebody's bound to mistake it for an olive.

ingredients.notes: 1 cuarto por cada 3 cuartos de ponche

recipes.method_original: Arrange elements in jug. Leave there, unsealed, for about ten days. Shake occasionally. When the great day arrives, strain through cheese cloth into punch bowl containing a large piece of ice. Add one quart of champagne before serving, and to every 3 quarts of the punch, add 1 quart carbonated water. Serve in highball glasses.
recipes.method_es: Coloque los ingredientes en una jarra. Déjelos, sin sellar, durante unos diez días. Agite ocasionalmente. Cuando llegue el gran día, cuele a través de gasa en una ponchera con un gran trozo de hielo. Añada un cuarto de champán antes de servir, y por cada 3 cuartos de ponche, añada 1 cuarto de agua carbonatada. Sirva en vasos highball.
recipes.raw_text:
REINDEER PUNCH
      4 quarts Calvert
      1 pint Curacao
      1 pint Jamaica Rum
      1 pint D. O. M. Benedictine
          pounds granulated sugar
      Juice 4 lemons
      1 quart champagne
 Arrange elements in jug. Leave there, unsealed, for about ten days. Shake occasionally. When the great day arrives, strain through cheese cloth into punch bowl containing a large piece of ice. Add one quart of champagne before serving, and to every 3 quarts of the punch, add 1 quart carbonated water. Serve in highball glasses. Recite one verse of 'The Night Before Christmas' after each serving.
